importers.tooltip:
Convert a Godot 4.1+ project (scenes, assets, scripts, GDExtensions) into an Aver project.

importers.description: Converts a Godot 4.1+ project (3D scenes, assets, scripts and GDExtensions) into a standalone Aver project. The Godot project is only read. What did not convert is listed in FabricReport.md.
